title: Azad tasks.yaml
description: A package of Azad declared as data (decision 0027). It means what the same tasks.star means.

package.description: What the package says of itself for the packages that depend on it (decision 0028).

deps.description: The package's immediate dependencies: packages, such as //libs/core, or sets of files and tasks, such as //libs/core:contracts.

exports.description: Patterns of the files that the package gives its dependents; by default all that git tracks.

provides.description: Tasks of the package, by name, whose outputs its dependents get.

file_sets.description: Named sets of the package's files, which other packages can depend on, by name.

uses.description: Calls of modules that return parts, such as the standard tasks of a kind of project.

tasks.description: The package's own tasks, by name.

goals.description: Goals beyond the roles' goals, by name.

config.description: A value of config.star, such as an image that it pins.

sources.description: Patterns of its files, relative to the package.

exclude.description: Patterns of files to leave out.

deps.description: The dependencies that come with the set.

module.description: A module that returns parts: <file>:<name>, such as //tools/azad/dotnet.star:standard.

with.description: The arguments of the call, by parameter.

cmd.description: One line that the shell runs, or a list of words: the program and its arguments.

sources.description: Patterns of the files that the task reads; after //, of the workspace.

exclude.description: Patterns of files to leave out of sources.

generates.description: Directories that the task writes, for the tasks after it.

deps.description: Tasks that must succeed first: names of this package, or labels such as //libs/logging:build.

image.description: The image of an isolated run: a reference with its digest, or a value of config.star.

env.description: Variables of the command. Put numbers in quotes.

caches.description: State that the task's tools keep between runs, by path, and the name of each.

network.description: Whether an isolated run has network access.

local.description: Where a local run runs the task.

secrets.description: Variables of azad's environment that the command gets in its image.

role.description: The role whose goal holds the task, such as test or fmt-check.

ci.description: Whether the goal ci holds the task; it needs a role.

dependencies.description: The dependencies that the task reads, with theirs: true for those of the package, or a list of them.

require.description: Tasks that must succeed: names of this package's tasks, or their labels.

on.description: The events on which the orchestrator runs the goal.
